Last Vehicle 1.14 weather and contact sounds — CC0 1.0 Universal

The original procedural synthesis, arrangement and edits in audio-v114 and the six lv114-* Ogg outputs are dedicated under CC0 1.0 Universal, to the extent copyright applies.

Previously bundled source recordings retain their CC0 dedications:
- qubodup — (defect) motor loop / fan_interval.wav: filtered motor texture in the designed city bed.
- Independent.nu, uploaded by qubodup — Dripping water loop: water/runoff texture in the designed entrance rain.
- Brian MacIntosh / BMacZero — Mechanical Sounds / clank1.wav: pitched metal contact in the bolt impact.
- Kenney — Interface Sounds 1.0 / Audio/switch_002.ogg: relay contact in the electrical cutoff.

The distant thunder and player exertion-breath loop are entirely original synthesis. The breath has no sampled voice or heartbeat and conveys only player stamina. The city and rain are designed composites, not claimed documentary location recordings. No microphone recording is required.

Exact immediate input hashes and complete original manifest/provenance entries are preserved in source-lock.json and manifest-fragment.json. The runtime-only package includes Audio-v114-source-lock.json and Audio-v114-provenance.json beside this notice.

This dedication applies only to these audio contributions and their authoring sources; it does not change unrelated project or dependency licenses.

CC0 summary: https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/
CC0 legal code: CC0-1.0.txt in the runtime licenses directory.
